Senior Frontend Engineer

Cobalt Harbor · Seattle, WA (Hybrid) · Posted 3 days ago
Full-timeEngineeringHybrid

Cobalt Harbor builds logistics software that helps ports and shipping lines plan every container move. You will own the planner UI used by thousands of dispatchers.

What you will do

  • Build and ship features in TypeScript and React for our dispatcher web app
  • Design fast, accessible data-heavy interfaces: maps, timelines and tables
  • Write Playwright and unit tests, and review code for a team of six
  • Work with product and design to shape the roadmap

What we look for

  • 5+ years building production web apps with TypeScript
  • Deep React experience, state management and performance tuning
  • Experience with testing: Playwright, Vitest or similar
  • Nice to have: GraphQL, WebGL or map rendering, mentoring juniors

Benefits

  • Hybrid: 2 days a week in the Seattle office
  • Health, dental and vision covered 100%
  • 25 days paid leave plus public holidays
  • Yearly learning and conference budget
